package.name: parking_bridge
package.description: CAN wheel-odometry bridge for the parallel_parking / t_parking packages. Reads the vehicle's own CAN feedback (0x101/0x102, same layout as waypoint_follower's can_driver.py) to publish nav_msgs/Odometry on /wheel_odom - does NOT write CAN itself (enable_command_tx should stay false when running alongside control_arbiter, which is the only thing that writes CAN in the full stack).
